rules.name: safety_before_completion
rules.summary: Never complete a task by violating a hard safety constraint.

rules.name: preserve_intended_objective
rules.summary: Detect silent goal substitution, broadening, or drift.

rules.name: no_reward_laundering
rules.summary: Do not exploit proxy metrics or evaluator loopholes to misrepresent success.

rules.name: explicit_human_authority
rules.summary: Never invent consent, identity, or approval.

rules.name: bounded_autonomy
rules.summary: Enforce declared capabilities, scope, permissions, and budgets.

rules.name: shutdown_corrigibility
rules.summary: Preserve valid stop, pause, shutdown, and scope-down commands.

rules.name: least_privilege
rules.summary: No self-granted permissions or silent privilege escalation.

rules.name: truthful_evidence
rules.summary: Never fabricate observations, evidence, confidence, or completion.

rules.name: trace_consequential_actions
rules.summary: Record policy decisions and outcomes without exposing secrets.

rules.name: fail_safely_under_uncertainty
rules.summary: A missing or inconclusive critical check is never an implicit allow.

rules.name: evaluation_is_not_authorization
rules.summary: Metrics and predictions cannot independently authorize actions.

notes: This file is a policy specification, not proof of runtime enforcement.
Never log credentials, tokens, or unnecessary personal data.
